name: The math inside a trading bot - applied to Nifty 50 and every F&O stock

catalogue.name: Log return
catalogue.how: Every series below runs on daily log returns.

catalogue.name: Annualized volatility
catalogue.how: NSE trades about 252 sessions a year (not 365).

catalogue.name: EWMA volatility
catalogue.how: λ = 0.94 (RiskMetrics).

catalogue.name: ATR
catalogue.how: Wilder 14; already used by the EMA 105 setup for its re-entry rule.

catalogue.name: Bad tick filter
catalogue.how: Flagged and listed, never deleted (results days and splits are real).

catalogue.name: No lookahead
catalogue.how: Daily filters use yesterday's close. The EMA 105 setup fills at the signal candle's close; re-run at the next open below.

catalogue.name: Z-score
catalogue.how: Close vs its 20-day mean.

catalogue.name: EMA
catalogue.how: The site's EMA 105 and EMA 50 use exactly this.

catalogue.name: Momentum 12-1
catalogue.how: Needs 1 year of history.

catalogue.name: RSI
catalogue.how: Wilder 14; the EMA 105 TOP exit is RSI 68.

catalogue.name: Order book imbalance
catalogue.how: Needs live bid/ask quantities (a broker feed); the closest end-of-day signal is the order-flow build-up.

catalogue.name: Funding carry
catalogue.how: India has no perpetual funding; the futures basis is the carry: (future − spot)/spot × 365/days to expiry.

catalogue.name: t-stat of returns
catalogue.how: On daily returns (non-overlapping) and on each strategy's trades.

catalogue.name: ADF test
catalogue.how: Dickey-Fuller without lags; on the price (almost never passes) and on the gap to the 50-day average.

catalogue.name: Half-life
catalogue.how: Sessions for the gap to the 50-day average to close halfway.

catalogue.name: Hurst exponent
catalogue.how: Rescaled range on up to 1,000 daily returns (not 200).

catalogue.name: Correlation
catalogue.how: Each stock vs Nifty 50, and the average pair inside the F&O list.

catalogue.name: Regime switch
catalogue.how: Per stock today.

catalogue.name: Expected value
catalogue.how: On every strategy, after costs.

catalogue.name: Expectancy in R
catalogue.how: 1R = the average losing trade.

catalogue.name: Bayesian win rate
catalogue.how: Flat Beta(1,1) prior: 22 of 32 becomes 67.6%, not 68.8%.

catalogue.name: Net edge
catalogue.how: Every backtest on the site takes 0.035% of price off each round trip.

catalogue.name: Risk-based size
catalogue.how: ₹10 lakh, 1% risk, stop = EMA 105 for every stock holding the EMA 105 setup.

catalogue.name: Kelly criterion
catalogue.how: Shown with half Kelly; backtest p is optimistic.

catalogue.name: Continuous Kelly
catalogue.how: Per trade.

catalogue.name: Volatility target
catalogue.how: 15% a year target, capped at 2×.

catalogue.name: Risk parity
catalogue.how: Across all F&O stocks.

catalogue.name: Liquidation price
catalogue.how: NSE futures use margin, not liquidation: the move that wipes the margin (~20% stocks, ~12% indices) in ATRs.

catalogue.name: Spread cost
catalogue.how: No bid/ask in any free end-of-day file.

catalogue.name: Microprice
catalogue.how: Needs the live order book.

catalogue.name: Square-root impact
catalogue.how: Q = 1 and 10 lots, V = 20-day average daily volume.

catalogue.name: VWAP
catalogue.how: Needs intraday volume; the Nifty index has no volume on Yahoo.

catalogue.name: Slippage
catalogue.how: Needs your own fills; log them when you trade.

catalogue.name: Maker vs taker
catalogue.how: Included in the 0.035% round-trip cost.

catalogue.name: Max drawdown
catalogue.how: 3 years per stock, and on every strategy.

catalogue.name: Value at Risk
catalogue.how: One day, one lot.

catalogue.name: Portfolio volatility
catalogue.how: Equal weight vs risk parity across all F&O stocks, last 252 days.

catalogue.name: Risk of ruin
catalogue.how: Only meaningful for even-money bets with p > 50%; shown for N = 10 units.

catalogue.name: Kill switch
catalogue.how: Set at the Monte Carlo 95th-percentile drawdown of each strategy.

catalogue.name: Sharpe ratio
catalogue.how: Per trade, annualised by trades a year.

catalogue.name: Multiple testing
catalogue.how: N = combinations tried before picking.

catalogue.name: Best of N noise
catalogue.how: σ_SR ≈ 1/√years.

catalogue.name: Walk-forward
catalogue.how: Every setup on the site is picked on the first 2/3 and judged on the unseen last 1/3.
